items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: Amos and I played together. We played the St. Louis Blues.

ctx.x: Well, I guess a few years ago, you somehow decided to go over to the New Orleans Jazz Club here in San Francisco. You really hadn't been too much in contact with that scene here, the kind of traditional jazz scene. Even though there were a lot of traditional players around San Francisco, Pops Foster and Darnell Howard. But about five or six years ago, suddenly you went back and started playing traditional jazz. How did that happen?
Amos White. Amos White invited me to one of the sessions.
